description: Paint a new anime background (scenery without characters) with the user's AniBG credits, when search_backgrounds has nothing that fits and the user wants it made. Needs the user's AniBG API key on this connection (header Authorization: Bearer anibg_…); without one the tool says where the user gets it, and studio_link is the way instead. Spends bought credits only: 2K costs 1, 4K costs 2 (free sign-up credits are for Studio). Describe a new place with prompt, or start from a library scene (scene, scene_time) or an earlier picture of the user (job) to change its time of day, shape or size, with prompt for changes. Waits up to wait seconds; if the picture is not done by then, call get_generation with its id. Example: {"prompt": "empty rooftop of a school at dusk, chain-link fence, water tank", "time": "sunset"}

job.description: The id of an earlier picture of this account to start from.

prompt.description: What the place looks like, in plain words, without people. Required unless scene or job is given; with them, what to change.

scene.description: A library scene id, like bg-014, to start from.

scene_time.description: With scene: which of the scene's pictures to start from (default: time, if the scene has it).

time.description: Time of day or weather (default day).

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the picture before answering (0 to 55, default 45). Most take 20 to 60 seconds.

name: generate_background
title: Paint a new background
